content: Aditya Singh called Suresh Deshmukh to confirm his selection of the Premium Plus insurance quote. They discussed the annual deductible (Rs. 7,500 for individuals, Rs. 15,000 for families), the requirement for pre-authorization on specialist visits (processed within 24-48 hours), and the renewal deadline of 5 October 2026 to avoid policy lapse before the 15 October 2026 expiration date. Suresh agreed to email the final quote and renewal form immediately.

topics: Policy renewal deadline and lapse consequences
action_items: Suresh Deshmukh to email the final quote PDF and renewal form to Aditya Singh
